author: Sarah Mitchell
text: Our 1926 Park Hill bungalow needed a full tear-off and I was dreading it. The crew found three rotten decking planks, showed me photos before replacing them at the per-sheet price already in the contract, and still finished in two days.

author: James Okafor
text: The June hailstorm hammered our neighborhood. Ridgeline tarped our worst leak the same evening, then their inspector met our adjuster on the roof and walked him through every chalk mark. New Class 4 roof went on three weeks later.

author: Linda Tran
text: Two other companies quoted a full replacement sight unseen. Ridgeline actually traced the leak to lifted step flashing next to the chimney, fixed it in one visit, and told me the roof itself has years left. That honesty earned them our replacement whenever it's actually due.

author: Robert Kaminski
text: Our HOA has opinions about everything, including shingle color. Ridgeline pulled the HOA spec before quoting, handled the approval paperwork, and installed the exact color on the approved list. Zero letters from the association, which around here is a miracle.

author: Angela Price
text: New seamless 6-inch gutters and guards on our two-story. Install crew was fast and the water test at the end was a nice touch. Only reason for four stars: scheduling pushed back a week during storm season. Once they were here, the work itself was flawless.

author: Tom Brandt
text: After losing shingles in three straight chinook events, we went standing-seam metal on Ridgeline's recommendation. First 90-mph gust since: not a rattle. Should have done it years ago.
